build_urdf_robot_model: build a UrdfRobotModel from a URDF file path to compute forward kinematics for robot links
compute_forward_kinematics: compute forward kinematics for robot joint states and return a dict mapping link names to SE3 poses
compute_jacobians: compute body or spatial jacobians for robot links by passing an empty dict to forward_kinematics
create_identity_model: create an IdentityModel KinematicsModel that returns a 2-DOF Point2 or Vector pose as-is
review_KinematicsModel: review the abstract KinematicsModel base class and its forward_kinematics interface for robot pose handling
